description: This file defines the 'Drug' class, which models a medication entity within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It includes properties such as identifiers, dosage information, related concepts, ingredients, and reference mappings. The class contains getter and setter methods, annotations for indexing and auditing, and utility methods for display purposes.

classes.name: Drug
classes.description: Represents a pharmaceutical drug with properties such as dosage, strength, concept associations, ingredients, and reference mappings. It extends BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata to include common metadata features.

methods.name: getDrugId
methods.description: Returns the internal identifier for the drug.

methods.name: setDrugId
methods.description: Sets the internal identifier for the drug.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Constructs a display name combining the drug's name and its concept.

methods.name: isCombination
methods.description: Deprecated method; indicates if the drug is a combination drug.

methods.name: getCombination
methods.description: Returns whether the drug is a combination drug.

methods.name: setCombination
methods.description: Sets whether the drug is a combination drug.

methods.name: getStrength
methods.description: Retrieves the drug's strength information.

methods.name: setStrength
methods.description: Sets the drug's strength information.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this drug.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates a concept with this drug.

methods.name: getDosageForm
methods.description: Gets the dosage form concept for the drug.

methods.name: setDosageForm
methods.description: Sets the dosage form concept for the drug.

methods.name: getMaximumDailyDose
methods.description: Returns the maximum daily dose recommended for the drug.

methods.name: setMaximumDailyDose
methods.description: Sets the maximum daily dose.

methods.name: getMinimumDailyDose
methods.description: Returns the minimum daily dose recommended for the drug.

methods.name: setMinimumDailyDose
methods.description: Sets the minimum daily dose.

methods.name: getIngredients
methods.description: Returns the collection of ingredients associated with the drug.

methods.name: setIngredients
methods.description: Sets the ingredients associated with the drug.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the object ID, an alias for getDrugId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the object ID, an alias for setDrugId.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display name for the drug.

methods.name: getDrugReferenceMaps
methods.description: Gets the set of reference mappings related to this drug.

methods.name: setDrugReferenceMaps
methods.description: Sets the drug reference mappings.

methods.name: addDrugReferenceMap
methods.description: Adds a new drug reference mapping, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: getDoseLimitUnits
methods.description: Retrieves the units used for dose limits.

methods.name: setDoseLimitUnits
methods.description: Sets the units used for dose limits.
